BiblicalUsage: The word is the bottom, and it appears once, when the men who accused Daniel are cast into the lions' den with their families, and the lions break their bones before they ever reach the bottom of the den.
TheologicalSignificance: The accusers fell to the very bottom they had dug for Daniel, and the den did the work they meant for him.
